title: Proof bundle verification result
description: The result of 'vlab verify-proof <file>'. Three checks are reported separately because they establish different things: integrity detects editing, classification detects a claim that does not follow from the stated evidence, and the repository comparison detects fabricated evidence. Only the last needs a repository (FR-PLAN-08).

integrity.description: Whether the bundle's own hash still matches its contents. Intact means unedited since production, not trustworthy: whoever produced it could restate the hash.

classification.description: Re-deriving every change from the bundle's own evidence and comparing with what it claims. This is the check that does not require a repository, and it catches a doctored status or proof even when the hash was restated.

repository.description: Comparison of the bundle's evidence with a live repository, the only check that catches fabricated evidence. Skipped rather than failed when the bundle is about a different repository, or when this one has moved on, since different heads legitimately produce different evidence.

reason.description: Why the comparison was skipped: not-requested, not-a-repository, bundle-incomplete, different-repository, target-moved, source-moved, or source-ref-missing. different-repository is checked first and is the only reason meaning the bundle will never apply here; the rest mean this repository has moved since the bundle was built.

ok.description: True when the hash is intact, every classification was reproduced, and the repository comparison did not contradict the evidence. A skipped repository comparison does not fail the result; it narrows what was proven, which the trust statement says.
